messages:
Alex: Quick proposal — let's run a 25m 'short-stack' triage pilot for the next 3 weeks. Goal: faster decisions + explicit owner assignment. Idea is tighter agenda, no deep dives. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sasha: +1 to experimenting. What exact day/time are you thinking? current slot is Wed 10am right now.

Jmora: I can own the rotation for week 1. Proposed compact agenda:
```
1) 5m quick state (incidents/blocks)
2) 10m highest-priority bugs (owners assigned)
3) 5m unblockers & short tickets
4) 5m follow-ups & next steps
```
Keeps it focused.

Maya: Will this collide with RFC/design review needs? we sometimes need 30m for those.

Alex: Good point. My thought: alternate cadence — short-stack on the 1st & 3rd Wed, full 45m RFC+triage on 2nd & 4th. If a design needs time, schedule a separate deep-dive.

Zane: I'm +1. Can we do 10:00 -> 10:25 to avoid afternoon client calls? Also please @oncall for infra-critical bugs.

Priya: I drafted a calendar event (placeholder) — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/short-stack-triage — will add rotation slots if we agree. :white_check_mark:

Sasha: Also suggest a short async pre-triage thread: owners paste 1-line items into the thread by EOD Tue so we queue the top items. saves time during the live call.

Jmora: I'll kick off the pre-thread for week 1. Format example: `BUG-1234 - segfault on inference worker - needs triage - @owner`

Oncall Bot: Scheduled reminder configured — will post a 30m summary of current queue and paging status before the meeting.

Alex: Thanks — quick poll: react :thumbsup: to run the 3-week pilot starting next Wed, :thumbsdown: to keep current format. I'll finalize and publish calendar + rotation by EOD today.

Sasha: :thumbsup:

Maya: :thumbsup:
